description: This bar chart illustrates the sample counts for different essay genres, categorized by writing condition. The horizontal axis represents the essay genre, with categories labeled “Argumentative,” “Narrative,” “Descriptive,” and “Expository,” presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Sample Count,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 122, with tick marks at intervals of 20.  For each genre, there are two bars representing the writing condition: “Open,” colored light blue, and “Cons.”, colored light red. The “Open” bars have heights of approximately 79, 80, 100, and 62, with exact values labeled above each bar. The “Cons.” bars have heights of approximately 122, 87, 68, and 130, with exact values labeled above each bar. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each genre, with the “Open” condition bar appearing to the left of the “Cons.” condition bar. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation, and the bars are arranged in order of genre.
